# Results - Indian district experiments (generated by make_report.py)

- Samples: 35368 district-crop-years, 308 districts, 20 states, 1359 district-crop series, target years 1987-2017.
- Per crop: Rice 8264, Wheat 7083, Maize 6372, Chickpea 5446, Kharif sorghum 4326, Pearl millet 3877.
- Weather: 311 districts, 12419 days; 37 missing daily values filled with day-of-year means; soil pH available for 295 districts (others: state median).
- Yield records dropped as implausible (> 5 x crop median): 116.
- Daily sensor behaviour: VSSM mean 0.174 (at 0 on 64% of days, at 1 on 3%); VSST mean 27.2 C (SD 6.7); VSCS mean 0.617 (SD 0.168).
- RMSE and MAE in t/ha for yield level, in log-ratio units for yield anomaly. Mean ± SD over seeds.

## Sensitivity of the virtual sensor parameters (latent arm, climate only; RMSE)


Temporal hold-out - Yield level, climate only (nominal RMSE 0.8953, raw inputs 0.8473):

| Parameter | -50% | -20% | +20% | +50% | Max change |
